[[FC Nantes]] won '''Division 1 season 1972/1973''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 55 points.

* [[RC Lens]]: Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group A
* [[Troyes AF]]: Runner-up, winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group B
* [[AS Monaco FC|AS Monaco]]: Third place, winner of barrages
